finalText:
17 call sites across 7 files still pass the legacy second argument (all `true`). Breakdown:

| File | Count |
|---|---|
| `src/reports/quarterly.js` | 5 (bundle, holdback, subtotal, surcharge, gross) |
| `src/admin/exports.js` | 3 (tip, commission, credit) |
| `src/billing/invoice.js` | 3 (tip, balance, payout) |
| `src/reports/monthly.js` | 2 (tip, settlement) |
| `src/checkout/cart.js` | 2 (prepayment, writeOff) |
| `src/checkout/receipt.js` | 1 (tip) |
| `src/billing/statement.js` | 1 (bundle) |

`src/reports/quarterly.js` has the most, with 5. The definition is at `src/lib/format.js:6` (`formatAmount(value, legacyRounding)`); files like `refunds.js`, `dashboard.js`, and `ledger.js` are already clean (single-arg only).
